The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column3: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column4:
to 
improve  mutual  understanding,  peaceful
coexistent, religious harmony, spiritual development
within  the  citizens  of  Sri  Lanka  through  religious,
cultural, social and economic inter activities;
to assist financially or otherwise in order to develop
personal skills and challenges enabling to concentrate
on self-employment;
to help by providing uniforms, instruments and text
books  for  the  needy  students  and  also  to  grant
scholarship for their secondary and tertiary education;
to  identify  fields  for  appropriate  projects  for  the
youths who leave from school and also support for
them through maintaining such projects in the focus
of training in order to face the competitive demand
for future employment opportunities;
to identify projects such as sport, music of students
in  the  divisional  and  rural  levels  and  motivate  for
improving  their  simultaneous  skills  through  by
maintaining  such  projects  in  order  to  face  the
competitive  demand  increasing  for  the  future
employment  opportunities;
to  provide  help  and  subsidy  to  improve  their
personality of the disabled persons;
to  create  a  human  generation  with  healthy,  polite,
patriotic  and  humanity  qualities  and  to  implement
programs in order to educate youths for promoting a
society free of tobacco, alcohol and drugs;
to identify the health related needs of the people in
the  far  away  rural  areas  and  conducting  clinic  and
medical  camps  for  such  areas  and  execute  medical
